name: Cartographer
ability: You start knowing how many Minions neighbor at least 1 Outsider. [+0 to +1 Outsider]

name: Burglar
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: you gain their ability. If both of you are alive, 1 of you is drunk.
firstNightReminder: The Burglar might choose a player, and might wake to the ability they stole.
otherNightReminder: The Burglar might choose a player, and might wake to the ability they stole.

jinxes.reason: If the Burglar gains the Butler ability, they learn this.
If the Burglar gains the Zealot ability, they learn this.
If the Burglar chooses the Wraith, they are drunk.
If the Burglar chooses the Vizier, their ability does not drunk a player.

name: Spymaster
ability: You think you are an Outsider, but you are not. The 1st time you die, you live and become a not-in-play Townsfolk.

name: Effigy
ability: Each night, choose a player: a chosen Demon learns who you are, and must attack you 1st tomorrow night.
firstNightReminder: The Effigy chooses a player, and is put to sleep. If a demon was chosen wake them and show the 'This Character Selected You' token, the Effigy token, and point to the Effigy.
otherNightReminder: The Effigy chooses a player, and is put to sleep. If a demon was chosen wake them and show the 'This Character Selected You' token, the Effigy token, and point to the Effigy.

jinxes.reason: If the Zombuul is chosen by the Effigy, they must attack them the next time they are able to attack a player.
The Effigy can only die to the Legion’s ability if they selected a good player the last night.
Each night, choose a player: a chosen evil player learns who you are, and you die tomorrow night.
If a living, sober, & healthy Effigy selected the player holding Lil’Monsta last night, Lil’Monsta attacks the Effigy tonight.
If a living, sober, & healthy Effigy selected the Yaggababble, the next Yaggababble kill must attack the Effigy.
Each night, choose a player: a chosen Minion will not become Riot on day 3 and learns this.

name: Naturalist
ability: The 1st time you die, if an Outsider is alive, an Outsider dies instead. [+0 to +1 Outsider]

name: Attorney
ability: If both of your nearest evil neighbors are alive, you can't die.

name: Matchmaker
ability: Each night, choose 2 players (not yourself): if they are different alignments, they can't die until dusk.

name: Merchant
ability: Each day, you may publicly choose any number of players. Tonight, if you chose an evil player, you die.
otherNightReminder: If the Merchant chose an evil player today, place a shroud on them.

name: Bartender
ability: Executees nominated by a player of the same alignment might not die.

name: Captain
ability: Each night, choose any number of players (not yourself): if all are good, they can't die by execution tomorrow.
firstNightReminder: The Captain chooses any number of players (not themselves).
otherNightReminder: The Captain chooses any number of players (not themselves).

name: Juror
ability: Each night*, learn the alignment of the player who was executed today.
otherNightReminder: Show a thumbs up, a thumbs down, or shake your head if no one was executed.

name: Pharmacist
ability: Each night, choose a fresh player: they are drunk until dusk. A chosen evil player learns this.
firstNightReminder: The Pharmacist chooses a player they have not chosen yet this game.
otherNightReminder: The Pharmacist chooses a player they have not chosen yet this game.

jinxes.reason: If the Pharmacist chooses the Vizier, the Vizier cannot die during the day.
If the Pharmacist chooses the Al-Hadikia, the picks are announced, but no one dies.
If the Pharmacist chooses the Leviathan, the Leviathan day is still announced.
If the Pharmacist chooses the player holding Lil'Monsta, Lil'Monsta is also drunked.

name: Mortician
ability: Each night*, choose up to 4 players: if at least 1 died tonight, learn how many evil players you chose.
otherNightReminder: The Mortician chooses up to 4 players.

name: Victim
ability: You think you are a Townsfolk, but you are not. You can die, even if for some other reason you can't.

name: Chekhov
ability: On your 1st night, choose 2 players (not yourself): if 1 is dead, the other might die at any time, even if you are dead.

name: Psychiatrist
ability: Each night*, choose a living player: a chosen evil Townsfolk or Outsider turns good and learns you are the Psychiatrist. [1 good character is evil]
firstNightReminder: Wake a good character and show the 'You Are' token, and give a thumbs down.
otherNightReminder: The Psychiatrist chooses a player, and is put to sleep. If an evil Townsfolk or Outsider was chosen, wake them and show the 'This Character Selected You' token, the Psychiatrist token, and point to the Psychiatrist.

name: Extortionist
ability: The last player to choose you with their ability might die at any time.

name: Poltergeist
ability: When you die, choose a player: they turn evil.
otherNightReminder: If the Poltergeist died today or tonight, wake the Poltergeist and they choose a player.

jinxes.reason: If the Storyteller gains the Poltergeist ability, a good player turns evil.

name: Mercenary
ability: Each night, choose 2 living players (both different from last night): if at least 1 is a Townsfolk, neither can die until dusk.
firstNightReminder: The Mercenary chooses 2 players (both different from last night).
otherNightReminder: The Mercenary chooses 2 players (both different from last night).

name: Anarchist
ability: Each night*, choose a player: a chosen Outsider dies. Outsiders you kill poison their nearest Townsfolk neighbor. [+1 Outsider]

name: Desperado
ability: Each night, choose a player: they learn this. If you chose yourself last night, tonight all previously chosen players die.
firstNightReminder: The Desperado chooses a player, and is put to sleep. The target is woken and shown the 'This Character Selected You' token, then the Desperado token.
otherNightReminder: The Desperado chooses a player, and is put to sleep. The target is woken and shown the 'This Character Selected You' token, then the Desperado token.

jinxes.reason: The Storyteller may choose themselves with the Desperado ability.

name: Boogeyman
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If a Minion died today, choose 2 players tonight.
otherNightReminder: The Boogeyman chooses a player, or 2 if a Minion died today.

name: Wyvern
ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. For every night this game you chose no-one (max of 2), you may choose another player. [-1 Outsider]
otherNightReminder: The Wyvern might choose to kill players, up to their max number of kills.

name: Aristocrat
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If an evil player died last night, evil players cannot die by execution if 5 or more players are alive.

name: Serpent
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you chose a neighbor, choose another player.
otherNightReminder: The Serpent chooses a player, or 2 if they select a neighbor.

name: Sweet Tooth
ability: Each night, choose a player: if they agree, the ST adds an extra ability to their character.
firstNightReminder: The Sweettooth chooses a player, and is put to sleep. Wake the target and show them the 'This Character Selected You' token, then the Sweettooth. The target gives thumbs up or thumbs down.
otherNightReminder: The Sweettooth chooses a player, and is put to sleep. Wake the target and show them the 'This Character Selected You' token, then the Sweettooth. The target gives thumbs up or thumbs down.

name: Executive
ability: Each day, immediately after a player gets enough votes to put them on the block, you may choose to take them off the block.

name: Viscount
ability: If the day would end with no execution, you choose who is executed.

name: Adjunct
ability: Majority is not needed to put a player on the block. If a player gets a majority of votes, they are immediately executed.
